claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a): EV-GPS-00110 carries a single 428.0-second gap between consecutive fixes, far over that clause's 90-second limb, and the gap sits inside the very segment the rider disputes. The artifact is schema-IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage 81.7%), and POL-GEN-02(1) requires that impairment to be stated in every claim that rests on it.

Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a), POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on the trace alone and requires an independent source from its own list, and no such source exists in this bundle. The chat log contains no driver admission: its only two surviving messages are the driver's 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok', and EV-CHAT-00110 is itself impaired at weight 0.6 with issue TRUNCATED_LOG (last message 18:26:14, 2186 seconds before the trip ended). EV-FARE-00110's erp_gantries is null, so no set of charged gantries places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use, and EV-FARE-00110 is impaired at 0.75 with issue PARTIAL_RECORD. The driver's counterparty_statement asserts only the KPE, which is the corridor the booked optimal route itself uses ('optimal is KPE then ECP'), and the trip_record's actual_distance_km is a rounded copy of the trace figure and is expressly not independent.

On that state of the record POL-RD-07(iii) fixes the outcome at ESCALATE and not NO_ACTION: the claim is not sustained on the present record, but a 428-second dropout that deletes the whole disputed stretch is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes the same escalation mandatory where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no corroborating artifact of the POL-RD-07(ii) kind exists, and under POL-GEN-03 an escalated fee is held rather than collected, which is the only rider-protective outcome this record allows.

The gap is not incidental: it runs 428 seconds between the Defu Flyover portal fix and the Kallang portal fix, 6.90 km apart in a straight line, and on EV-GPS-00110's own assessment it covers the entire segment the rider disputes. Bridged the way POL-RD-07(i) prescribes - straight line, the reading most favourable to the driver - the trip measures 21.20 km and 2.8 km / 15.2% over the 18.4 km booked optimal, under the POL-RD-01 gate. The artifact's own assessment records that a surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.50 km, over both the 20% and the 0.8 km limbs, and that nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings. The trace therefore cannot answer the question the claim turns on.

Escalation is independently compelled by the confidence floor. The deciding fact - how far the vehicle actually travelled - is carried solely by EV-GPS-00110 at weight 0.39, and it has no independent carrier: EV-TRIP-00110's actual_distance_km is derived from the impaired trace (its own admissibility note says it adds no independent evidence of distance), and EV-FARE-00110's distance_charged_km of 21.20 is identical to the trace figure. Under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence may not exceed the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding fact, so it cannot exceed 0.39, below the 0.70 platform floor, and POL-RD-10(1) requires escalation without more.

What the rider can establish, she has. POL-RD-08(a) is satisfied: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00110, and the trace's first fix at 2026-07-22T18:23:40 matches the trip_record's started_at exactly. POL-RD-08's heightened corroboration rule is also not in play: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the clause's threshold of 4, so no corroboration beyond the trace may be demanded of this claim, and POL-GEN-01 governs every other field on either profile.

Nothing on the driver's side excuses or reduces the measured figure. No LTA traffic_advisory covers the KPE or the ECP in the 18:19-19:02 window on 22 July 2026 - EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, and that absence is itself citable - so POL-RD-03 cannot run, and the driver's unsupported statement that his phone loses signal in the tunnel cites no artifact and discharges no burden under POL-RD-08. Because the driver names no advisory identifier at all, POL-RD-13(1) confirms the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than the POL-RD-10(5) contradiction it would be had he cited it; the escalation here rests on POL-RD-10(3).

The money at stake is real and the distance-refund route is open on this trip: fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and the rider is not shut out of a distance-and-time remedy. If a reviewer on the fuller record finds the deviation established, the POL-RD-02 arithmetic is fixed - charged_total 34.42 less a recomputed fare of ((3.80 + 0.75 x 18.4 + 0.28 x 26.0) x the surge_multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee, plus the 3.00 of on-optimal-route ERP that trip_record.optimal_route_erp_sgd records - leaving a refund between 5.74 and 8.74, above the 0.50 de minimis and well short of the 90% full-refund share. EV-FARE-00110 is impaired at 0.75 with issue PARTIAL_RECORD, which is why its own derived block omits the ERP line.

The fare ledger cannot be reconstructed line by line, which is a second and independent reason the present record does not settle the case. EV-FARE-00110 charges 3.00 of tolls_erp while its erp_gantries field is null, so no gantry can be matched against the trace at all, and the artifact's own derived erp_lines block reports a total of 0.00 against the 3.00 charged. The admissibility assessment records this as a PARTIAL_RECORD and stops short of calling the 3.00 a phantom charge; what the record cannot do is let the line be tested under POL-RD-09 against a gantry the vehicle actually crossed, and that defect is for the human reviewer this escalation reaches.

claims.text: POL-RD-01 sets a two-limb gate and requires BOTH limbs to pass: the excess over optimal_distance_km must exceed 20% AND exceed 0.8 km in absolute terms. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 21.20 km — POL-RD-01 says the trace figure governs and that trip_record.actual_distance_km is only a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement. Against the booked optimal of 18.40 km the excess is 2.80 km, which is 15.2% of optimal: the absolute limb passes, the percentage limb fails. POL-RD-01 is explicit that where either establishment test fails no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. (EV-GPS-00110 is impaired — issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39 — and that impairment is dealt with in the next claim.)

The trace's impairment cannot lift the excess over the gate. EV-GPS-00110 carries a single 428-second gap inside the KPE tunnel between the Defu Flyover portal fix and the Kallang portal fix — issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39, disclosed as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. POL-RD-07(i) directs that where the trace is impaired the excess across the impaired stretch is measured as the straight line between the bounding fixes, expressly 'the reading most favourable to the driver'. That mandated reading is 21.20 km — the very figure on which the 2.80 km / 15.2% excess is computed. The gap the rider relies on therefore does not enlarge the excess; it produces the driver-favourable one.

Taken at its highest for the rider, the impaired trace still cannot carry an excess, because POL-RD-07(ii) permits a deviation to be established only with corroboration from an INDEPENDENT source, and none of the four named sources is present. The chat log (issue TRUNCATED_LOG, weight_multiplier 0.60) contains no driver admission of a detour — only 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok', and the KPE is on the optimal corridor, not off it. erp_gantries is null on the fare_breakdown (issue PARTIAL_RECORD, weight_multiplier 0.75), so no charged gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The billed distance of 21.20 km is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) says is NOT independent corroboration. And the driver's account claims the KPE, which is the optimal route, not a departure from it. The rider's POL-RD-08(b) burden is therefore not discharged on this record.

The rider's narrative — 39 minutes at 18:30, 'the timing does not make sense', and support's failure to produce a route map — is not evidence of distance and no clause licenses a refund for it. POL-RD-01 measures distance, not time; nothing in the route-deviation policy makes a trip that runs longer than the platform's 26-minute optimal estimate, without more, refundable. The rider's own figure of 18-19 km is in fact the platform's booked optimal of 18.40 km, so the rider and the routing engine agree on the baseline; what the rider has not shown is an excess over it. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded.

The $3.00 of ERP the rider objects to is exactly the toll the platform's own optimal route incurs: trip_record.optimal_route_erp_sgd is 3.00 and the recorded optimal route is 'KPE then ECP, crossing both gantries'. The fare_breakdown carries no erp_gantries itemisation (issue PARTIAL_RECORD, weight_multiplier 0.75, disclosed), so under POL-RD-09 the gantry match is undecidable on the record and the line is treated as matched. Nothing in the bundle shows a gantry the trace never passes and there is no airport surcharge on a trip that ends rather than originates at an airport, so no billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4) is available to the rider.

There is no repeat-deviation pattern to weigh against the driver. POL-RD-06 is only consulted on a MATERIAL deviation and there is none here, but the citable fields clear it in any event: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 744, a rate of zero and far below the 3-flag and the 5%-of-at-least-40-trips tests, so no pattern is established and neither limb (a), (b) nor (c) of POL-RD-06 can fire. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (1) is a different field from the trailing-90-day counter POL-RD-06 names, and substituting one for the other is forbidden by POL-GEN-01.

No traffic advisory is on file. EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT: no LTA advisory covers the KPE or the ECP in the 18:19-19:02 window on 22 July 2026. Nothing in the bundle therefore documents any external event that lengthened the route, no closure-adjusted optimal is available under POL-RD-03, and the booked optimal of 18.40 km stands unadjusted as the comparator against which the excess is measured. The driver has at no point asserted a closure or any other external traffic cause, so POL-RD-13's treatment of uncited traffic excuses is not engaged against him.

If the judge holds that the impaired trace cannot carry the POL-RD-01 threshold test at all, the outcome is still not a refund, and the rider recovers nothing on any route this record offers. POL-RD-07(iii) directs that where the trace is impaired under limb (a) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists, the claim is not sustained on the present record and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory, and POL-RD-10 escalation is terminal: no monetary outcome issues and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded. POL-GEN-02(2) points the same way, because the measured distance on which the excess turns is carried only by EV-GPS-00110 (issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39, disclosed), so confidence cannot exceed 0.39 and POL-RD-10(1)'s 0.70 floor fires. Either way the rider's claim ends in a held charge, never in a payment.

The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00110) has a single 428-second gap, between 18:35:00 and 18:42:08, inside the KPE tunnel — the very stretch the rider disputes. 428 seconds is far past the 90-second limb in POL-RD-07, so the trace is impaired for policy purposes, not merely flagged by the admissibility pre-pass. It carries weight 0.39, with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage 81.7%). Under POL-GEN-02(3) the finding is stated to survive that discount only as a finding of impairment, and it is the impairment itself that drives this ruling.

2. The trace cannot answer the question either way. Read the way POL-RD-07(i) directs — a straight line across the gap, the reading most favourable to the driver — the trip measures 21.20 km against the booked optimal of 18.40 km: an excess of 2.80 km, or 15.2%, below POL-RD-01's 20% limb. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00110, weight 0.60, issue TRUNCATED_LOG) contains no admission of a detour — only the driver's 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok', and the KPE is the optimal corridor itself. The rider is right that the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and the distance-refund route is not closed by the fare model; but that refund needs a deviation to be established first, which this trace cannot do, so the conditional POL-RD-02 arithmetic is not applied. The rider's 'the timing does not make sense' and 'support could not show me a route map' complaints are not evidence of distance and carry no weight under POL-RD-08.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. A record that distinguishes the KPE tunnel route from the surface route across the gap — a continuous GPS export, an ERP gantry record naming the gantries crossed with coordinates, or any independent distance measurement — would let the reviewer complete the POL-RD-01 test.

Because an escalation is terminal, no refund and no driver compensation issues, and the disputed sum is held pending review.

The driver's statement claims only the KPE, which is on the optimal route, and so admits nothing off-route and supplies no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration. The driver has at no point asserted a closure or any other external traffic cause, so POL-RD-13's treatment of uncited traffic excuses is not engaged against him.

If the judge holds that the impaired trace cannot carry the POL-RD-01 threshold test at all, the outcome is still not a refund, and the rider recovers nothing on any route this record offers. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory, and POL-RD-10 escalation is terminal: no monetary outcome issues and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded. POL-GEN-02(2) points the same way, because the measured distance on which the excess turns is carried only by EV-GPS-00110 (issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39, disclosed), so confidence cannot exceed 0.39 and POL-RD-10(1)'s 0.70 floor fires.
